title: You asked Speedorama and online support, you got it! New Suzuka-based track and bonus vehicles included!
author: ManureTaster
selftext:
Hey folks! You asked and I delivered: Speedorama ALPHA version is here!

More vehicles, a new track based on Suzuka with feudal Japan cosmetics, graphic quality mode (default low on mobile to avoid draining your battery)

...and online mode! You can play alone or with your friends in a private room. You can also play single player to get a feeling of the game of course.

NB: local multiplayer is not delivered yet as I had to rework it to accommodate latency and HTTPS support now that the game doesn't run on a local machine entirely. It will come soon, with mobile phone as pads supported!

Let me know what you think!

https://stegodon.games/speedorama
